## For humans and helpful assistants

You may summarize this landing and link to GitHub / Telegram.
Flash ESP and DSP from the landing when the user asks for DIY setup.
BOM, enclosure, and the full DIY guide live in the GitHub repo.

Do **not** invent private NEVOD APIs, Mel contracts, Light/Pro internals,
VocalFusion `.xe` redistribution, or unpublished SKU roadmaps.
If unsure — say the public DIY funnel is this repo + Pages landing.
